This uses **step-file architecture** for disciplined execution:

- **Micro-file Design**: Each step is self-contained and followed exactly
- **Just-In-Time Loading**: Only load the current step file
- **Sequential Enforcement**: Complete steps in order, no skipping
- **State Tracking**: Persist progress via spec frontmatter and in-memory variables
- **Append-Only Building**: Build artifacts incrementally

### Step Processing Rules

1. **READ COMPLETELY**: Read the entire step file before acting
2. **FOLLOW SEQUENCE**: Execute sections in order

4. **LOAD NEXT**: When directed, read fully and follow the next step file

### Critical Rules (NO EXCEPTIONS)

- **NEVER** load multiple step files simultaneously

1	# Epic 1 Context: Foundation & Session Management
2	
3	<!-- Compiled from planning artifacts. Edit freely. Regenerate with compile-epic-context if planning docs change. -->
4	
5	## Goal
6	
7	This epic delivers the scaffold every other feature depends on: the pinned-stack project setup with its core infrastructure verified working together, the full visual design-token system, email/password authentication with silent session refresh, the session-expiry recovery overlay, and a base navigation shell with placeholders for everything not yet built. It is delivered first because every later epic assumes this foundation — DI, networking, error handling, session state, design tokens, and navigation — already exists and is stable. Users come away able to create an account, log in, stay logged in across restarts, recover gracefully if their session expires mid-use, and navigate the whole app shell even though most feature screens are still placeholders.
8	
9	## Stories
10	
11	- Story 1.1: Project Scaffold, Stack Integration & Core Infrastructure
12	- Story 1.2: Design Token System & Core Component Library
13	- Story 1.3: Account Creation and Login
14	- Story 1.4: Silent Session Refresh & Persistence
15	- Story 1.5: Expired-Session Recovery Overlay
16	- Story 1.6: Base Navigation Shell with Feature Placeholders
17	
18	## Requirements & Constraints
19	
20	- Account creation and login round-trip through the backend with exactly two fields (email, password) — no password confirmation, no display-name field at signup. Login/signup/refresh are the only calls using the anon key; every other call uses the user's access token.
21	- A valid, unexpired session must persist across app restarts with no re-prompt; nearing/past-expiry sessions refresh silently with no visible loading UI unless the call exceeds 300ms.

# Epic 1 Context: Foundation & Session Management

<!-- Compiled from planning artifacts. Edit freely. Regenerate with compile-epic-context if planning docs change. -->

## Goal

This epic delivers the scaffold every other feature depends on: the pinned-stack project setup with its core infrastructure verified working together, the full visual design-token system, email/password authentication with silent session refresh, the session-expiry recovery overlay, and a base navigation shell with placeholders for everything not yet built. It is delivered first because every later epic assumes this foundation — DI, networking, error handling, session state, design tokens, and navigation — already exists and is stable. Users come away able to create an account, log in, stay logged in across restarts, recover gracefully if their session expires mid-use, and navigate the whole app shell even though most feature screens are still placeholders.

## Stories

- Story 1.1: Project Scaffold, Stack Integration & Core Infrastructure
- Story 1.2: Design Token System & Core Component Library
- Story 1.3: Account Creation and Login
- Story 1.4: Silent Session Refresh & Persistence
- Story 1.5: Expired-Session Recovery Overlay
- Story 1.6: Base Navigation Shell with Feature Placeholders

## Requirements & Constraints

- Account creation and login round-trip through the backend with exactly two fields (email, password) — no password confirmation, no display-name field at signup. Login/signup/refresh are the only calls using the anon key; every other call uses the user's access token.
- A valid, unexpired session must persist across app restarts with no re-prompt; nearing/past-expiry sessions refresh silently with no visible loading UI unless the call exceeds 300ms.
- When the backend reports an expired session, an overlay appears over whatever screen is active (never a navigation away); the underlying screen's state/scroll position is preserved; "Entrar novamente" leads to biometric/PIN re-auth, not a login form.
- All four base destinations (Home/Chat, side menu, Meus Registros, Configurações) must be reachable from launch; any destination whose feature isn't built yet shows a visually distinct, fully-polished placeholder — never a broken link and never a visibly "unfinished" look.
- Local UI interactions must respond in <100ms; any network call >300ms shows a loading indicator (manual timing spot-check, no automated perf tooling).
- Zero Clean Architecture layer violations: domain imports neither Flutter nor anything from a data layer.
- ≥80% domain-layer test coverage; the write-failure matrix (5 write endpoints × 3 failure types: timeout, malformed response, no connection = 15 scenarios) must be fully handled with zero unhandled exceptions — this epic builds the one shared, reusable test helper every later feature's write-endpoint tests reuse.
- Zero hardcoded visual values outside the design-tokens file; every control must honor Dynamic Type without truncating.
- An integration spike, before any other building, must prove `dio` + `flutter_secure_storage` + `get_it` work together in one bootstrap — this combination is otherwise unverified.

## Technical Decisions

- Single DI container: exactly one `get_it` instance registered at bootstrap; `dio` is configured through it; secrets (`FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`) load via `flutter_dotenv` from a gitignored `.env`, never hardcoded.
- One sealed `Failure` hierarchy, exactly 14 subtypes (13 from the backend's error taxonomy plus a local-only `MalformedResponse`), defined once and never redefined/subset per feature; every repository method returns `Future<Either<Failure, T>>` (or a `Stream` for SSE), with no native/dio exception ever escaping unmapped.
- One retry interceptor on the `dio`/`ApiClient` layer retries only the 6 server-marked `retryable:true` codes; every other failure surfaces once, unretried.
- One URL builder maps every operation to `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<x-cerne-function>/<path-params>` (never the literal OpenAPI REST path); one interceptor owns headers — `apikey` on every call, anon-key bearer token only on signup/login/refresh, user access token on everything else.
- Exactly one `SessionStatus` stream is exposed from the auth feature's domain layer and registered once in DI as a singleton; every later consumer (including RF07/Epic 4) injects/listens to it rather than re-deriving session validity from a raw 401 or a second stream.
- This epic builds the `go_router` redirect skeleton composing session state; Epic 2 (RF03) later plugs a local vault-status gate into the same redirect, checked before session status — this epic should leave that composition point open rather than hardcoding a session-only redirect.
- Strict layer direction applies project-wide: only `data/` imports `dio`/`hive_ce`/platform plugins; `presentation/` never imports any feature's `data/` directly; a BLoC/Cubit constructor never takes another BLoC/Cubit as a dependency.
- Structural seed to scaffold: `lib/core/{design_tokens.dart, network/, failure/, di/, cache/, resource.dart, isolated_side_effect.dart, session/}` and `lib/features/{auth, vault, entries, capture, chat, export, dashboard, account}/`, each pre-wired for `data/domain/presentation`.
- Full stack is pinned (Flutter 3.47.x via `fvm`; `flutter_bloc`, `go_router`, `dio`, `hive_ce`, `get_it`, `fpdart`, `freezed`, `json_serializable`, `mocktail`, `fl_chart`, `local_auth`, `flutter_secure_storage`, `flutter_dotenv`, `whisper_ggml` — exact versions in the architecture spine's stack-pins table) and must resolve with no conflicts before anything else is built.
- Design tokens (`colors`, `typography`, `rounded`, `spacing`, `components`, plus the two elevation constants) are implemented verbatim, camelCase, as the single source of truth; every other file reads from them, never redefines a value.

## UX & Interaction Patterns

- Single fixed frame: 390×844 logical points, portrait only, light mode only — no breakpoint, landscape, or dark-mode path anywhere in the app.
- Buttons and text fields come from one shared component set: disabled buttons always render `colorBorder` background + `colorTextSecondary` text (never dimmed opacity); text fields show distinct default/focused(`colorPrimary`, 1.5px)/error(`colorError`) border states.
- The side menu is the sole navigation hub (plus back arrows and sheet "x" closes) — no drawer-within-drawer, no tab bar. It must resolve all four destinations (chat session switching, Meus Registros, Configurações, Planos de Ação) without a 404 or crash.
- The Planos de Ação placeholder (an explicit, never-implemented extension feature) must still look fully finished — same visual polish as real screens, no graying-out, no backend calls, no drag/drop logic.
- The avatar component (solid `colorPrimary` circle, 1–2 uppercase initials, 40px) is built here for reuse, not reimplementation, when Configurações needs its 52px variant later (Epic 8).
- The "Sessão expirada" overlay is a scrim over the current screen using the confirmation-dialog component with a neutral (`colorTextPrimary`) title — never the red destructive-title variant. It traps focus until dismissed/actioned, is the only overlay allowed on screen at a time (never stacks on another open overlay), and its entrance uses only the `scrimIn` (0.18s) choreography — no other motion exists in the system besides `sheetUp` for bottom sheets.
- Copy for the overlay must avoid any language implying data loss or starting over; history and scroll position are understood by the user to be preserved.

## Cross-Story Dependencies

- Story 1.1 (DI, API client, Failure hierarchy, URL builder, retry interceptor, shared failure-matrix test helper) is a hard prerequisite for every other story in this epic and for every later epic's write-endpoint tests.
- Story 1.2's design tokens and base components (buttons, text fields, avatar) are consumed by Story 1.3's login/signup screen, Story 1.5's overlay, and Story 1.6's navigation shell/placeholders.
- Story 1.4 depends on Story 1.3's auth calls and exposes the singleton `SessionStatus` stream that Story 1.5 listens to and that the `go_router` redirect skeleton composes.
- Story 1.5's "Entrar novamente" action routes to the biometric/PIN re-auth flow that is not built until Epic 2 — this epic should wire the route target without implementing that flow.
- Story 1.6's `go_router` redirect skeleton is extended by Epic 2 (RF03), which plugs in the local vault-status gate ahead of the session gate already built here, in a fixed order (vault checked first).
- Story 1.6's avatar component and placeholder-styling pattern are reused as-is by Epic 8 (Configurações' 52px avatar, other placeholder surfaces).

---
title: 'Story 1.2: Design Token System & Core Component Library'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-10-27'
status: 'done'
review_loop_iteration: 0
baseline_commit: '164e1d259a206420d612c5378adf74fefa72772c'
context:
  - '{project-root}/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/epic-1-context.md'
  - '{project-root}/docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md'
  - '{project-root}/_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/architecture/architecture-cerne-ciclo-b-2026-10-26/ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` is a typed stub (Story 1.1), and no shared, reusable UI widgets exist yet; Stories 1.3, 1.5 and 1.6 each need real colors/typography/spacing/radii and a button/text-field/avatar to build against instead of inventing their own.

**Approach:** Implement `design_tokens.dart` verbatim from `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md` §3, bundle the three prototype type families as static font assets, and build the three cross-feature widgets the epic names as consumed downstream (button variants, text field, avatar) in a new `lib/core/widgets/` location.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Every color/typography/spacing/radius/elevation value in `design_tokens.dart` matches `prototype-extract.md` §3 verbatim; nothing is redefined or hardcoded elsewhere (RNF08).
- Disabled buttons render `colorBorder` background + `colorTextSecondary` text, never dimmed opacity; text fields expose default/focused(`colorPrimary`, 1.5px)/error(`colorError`) border states.
- Every widget honors Dynamic Type — no fixed-height text container that can clip or truncate.
- `core/widgets/` contains only stateless, feature-agnostic presentation primitives — no BLoC, no feature imports, no `data/`/`domain/` coupling (RNF06 applies transitively: these are consumed by every feature's `presentation/`).

**Never:**
- No component outside buttons (primary/secondary-outline/text-ghost), text field, and avatar — every other row in `prototype-extract.md` §6 (chat bubble, insight card, sync badge, filter chip, record card, confirmation dialog, PIN keypad, tab bar, waveform, skeleton, bar chart, persona/kanban cards) ships with the story that first needs it.
- No `google_fonts` runtime-fetch package — fonts are static bundled assets, so widget tests stay deterministic with no device/network (no CI exists yet).
- No extension-feature styling (persona cards, kanban) — out of scope project-wide.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Button disabled | `onPressed == null` | `colorBorder` background, `colorTextSecondary` text, no ripple/pressed feedback | N/A |
| Text field error | `errorText != null` | 1.5px `colorError` border, error text shown below field | N/A |
| Dynamic Type max scale | System text-scale increased | Label wraps/grows; never clips or truncates | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` -- placeholder stub to replace with real `colors`/`typography`/`spacing`/`radii`/`elevation` constants (currently just a doc comment pointing here).
- `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md` §3 (tokens) and §6 (component table) -- read-only ground truth for every literal value and the exact variations each widget must support.
- `pubspec.yaml` -- add a `fonts:` section + `assets/fonts/` entries for Fraunces, Karla, IBM Plex Mono (no such section exists today; only `.env` is declared as an asset).
- `lib/core/widgets/` -- new directory; architecture spine's Structural Seed is silent on where cross-feature shared widgets live (only `core/design_tokens.dart` is named) — decided here per AGENTS.md's "decide and proceed" policy, analogous placement to `core/design_tokens.dart`.
- `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/epic-1-context.md` Cross-Story Dependencies -- names exactly this story's output (tokens + buttons/text fields/avatar) as what 1.3/1.5/1.6 consume; do not expand scope beyond it.
- `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-1-1-project-scaffold-stack-integration-core-infrastructure.md` Design Notes -- precedent pattern for documenting a decided silent-gap.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` -- implement real color/typography/spacing/radii/elevation constants verbatim from `prototype-extract.md` §3 -- RNF08 single source of truth
- [x] `assets/fonts/*` + `pubspec.yaml` -- bundle Fraunces/Karla/IBM Plex Mono as static font assets -- deterministic text rendering with no device/CI
- [x] `lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart` -- primary, secondary (outline), text (ghost) variants with the disabled-state rule -- consumed by 1.3/1.5/1.6
- [x] `lib/core/widgets/app_text_field.dart` -- default/focused/error border states -- consumed by 1.3
- [x] `lib/core/widgets/avatar.dart` -- initials circle, 40px and 52px size variants -- consumed by 1.6 and Epic 8
- [x] `test/core/widgets/app_button_test.dart`, `app_text_field_test.dart`, `avatar_test.dart` -- cover every visual state listed in the I/O matrix and §6
- [x] `test/core/design_tokens_test.dart` -- spot-check token values against `prototype-extract.md` §3

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given any token category, when read from `design_tokens.dart`, then its value matches `prototype-extract.md` §3 verbatim.
- Given a repo-wide search for color/font/spacing/radius literals outside `design_tokens.dart`, then none exist (RNF08).
- Given the disabled button state, when rendered, then background is `colorBorder` and text is `colorTextSecondary`.
- Given the text field error state, when rendered, then the border is 1.5px `colorError`.
- Given increased system Dynamic Type scale, when any of the three widgets render, then no label clips or truncates.

### Review Findings

- [x] [Review][Patch] Remove unreachable `disabledBorder` in `AppTextField` — no `enabled` param exists to ever trigger it [lib/core/widgets/app_text_field.dart:81]
- [x] [Review][Patch] Run `dart format` on the three new widget files — not formatter-clean as committed [lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart, lib/core/widgets/app_text_field.dart, lib/core/widgets/avatar.dart]
- [x] [Review][Defer] `AppButton` has no loading/busy state for async call sites (login submit, "Salvar", export actions) [lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart] — deferred, pre-existing
- [x] [Review][Defer] `AppTextField` lacks `enabled`/`readOnly`/`onSubmitted`/`autofocus`/`textCapitalization`/`inputFormatters` — first real consumer (Story 1.3) should request what it needs [lib/core/widgets/app_text_field.dart] — deferred, pre-existing
- [x] [Review][Defer] `design_tokens.dart` now imports `package:flutter/widgets.dart` with no lint/architecture test guarding a future `domain/` layer from importing it (RNF06 risk) [lib/core/design_tokens.dart:1] — deferred, pre-existing

## Spec Change Log

- **Review round 1 (patch findings, no spec-level change):** three parallel reviews (blind-hunter, edge-case-hunter, verification-gap) surfaced 6 distinct patchable gaps, all fixed in place: (1) added a `DesignTokens — layout insets` test group for `buttonPadding`/`textFieldContentPadding`/`avatarInitialsPadding`, previously untested; (2) added a `side.resolve({disabled})` assertion to `AppButton`'s secondaryOutline disabled test; (3) `AppButton.secondaryOutline`'s `BorderSide` now passes `width: DesignTokens.borderWidthDefault` explicitly instead of silently falling back to Flutter's default (RNF08 literal bypass); (4) documented the button-corner-radius decision below (was undocumented); (5) corrected `AppTextField.errorText`'s doc comment, which overstated the contract ("non-null and non-empty") beyond the frozen spec's actual `errorText != null` condition; (6) added `radiusSm` assertions to the `AppButton` primary and `AppTextField` default-state tests. Rejected as non-issues: `textColor` no-op on non-ghost variants (documented by design), `Avatar` empty-initials fallback (caller's responsibility per its own doc), missing pressed-overlay on secondary/ghost (prototype never defines one), barrel file/a11y/form-hooks suggestions (deferred or out of scope, see `deferred-work.md`).

## Design Notes

Gaps silent in all planning docs, decided here per AGENTS.md's "decide and proceed" policy:
- **Shared widget location:** `lib/core/widgets/` — the Structural Seed only names `core/design_tokens.dart`; this is the natural cross-feature home since Clean Architecture already lets `presentation/` depend on `core/`.
- **Font sourcing:** static `.ttf` files committed under `assets/fonts/` and declared in `pubspec.yaml`'s `fonts:` section — not the `google_fonts` package, which fetches at runtime by default and would make widget tests depend on network access with no device/CI yet. Fraunces and Karla ship from Google Fonts only as variable fonts (single file, `wght` axis, no static per-weight instances in the upstream repo); each is declared once per weight actually used by a typography token (`Fraunces-Variable.ttf` at weight 600; `Karla-Variable.ttf` at 400/500/700), which is Flutter's documented pattern for selecting a named instance via `TextStyle.fontWeight` — the files themselves are still fully static/offline, satisfying the "no runtime fetch" intent even though the underlying format is variable. IBM Plex Mono ships its own static `Medium` (500) instance, matching `textMonoCaption` exactly.
- **Epic context's "components" token category:** resolved as a handful of named constants that don't fit color/typography/spacing/radii (avatar sizes 40/52dp, default/focused-or-error border widths 1/1.5dp) — still declared inside `design_tokens.dart`, just grouped for readability.
- **Two colors named in prototype-extract.md §3 but outside its Design Tokens panel** (`colorChatBubbleUser` `#D9DFD3`, `colorCategoryChipText` `#3F4A38`) — added to `design_tokens.dart` now rather than left for whichever later story first renders a chat bubble or category chip, so RNF08 ("nothing is redefined or hardcoded elsewhere") holds from day one instead of being retrofitted.
- **Per-widget `EdgeInsets` constants** (`buttonPadding`, `textFieldContentPadding`, `avatarInitialsPadding`): not named anywhere in `prototype-extract.md` §3, but required so `lib/core/widgets/*.dart` never constructs `EdgeInsets.symmetric/all/only` directly — the Verification section's literal grep (`EdgeInsets\.(all|symmetric|only)(`) checks for the construction call itself, not just raw numbers, so these live in `design_tokens.dart` too, built from the existing spacing scale.
- **Disabled-state uniformity across button variants:** the Boundaries bullet and I/O matrix state the `colorBorder` background / `colorTextSecondary` text disabled rule generically ("Disabled buttons..."), and §6's component table only spells it out for the primary variant. Applied uniformly to all three variants (including secondary-outline and text-ghost, whose disabled state briefly gains a filled `colorBorder` background) for one consistent, testable rule rather than inventing a second disabled treatment for the other two.
- **Avatar vs. the "no fixed-height text container" rule:** the avatar circle is a fixed 40/52dp size by design (a token, not a text-driven container). It wraps its initials in a `FittedBox(fit: BoxFit.scaleDown)` so at extreme Dynamic Type scales the initials shrink to fit rather than clip or truncate — satisfying the letter of "never clips or truncates" without growing the circle itself.
- **Button corner radius:** `radiusSm` (8dp), applied to all three `AppButton` variants. `prototype-extract.md` §3's Radii section only names "inputs, chips" for `radiusSm` and never assigns a radius to buttons by name — buttons are the closest analog in size and visual weight to chips/inputs, so `radiusSm` was chosen over introducing an undocumented new radius value.
- **Pressed-state color via `overlayColor`:** `AppButton`'s primary variant resolves `ButtonStyle.overlayColor` to the exact `colorPrimaryPressed` token (opaque) on `WidgetState.pressed`, rather than relying on Material's default semi-transparent overlay tint — keeps the pressed color exact and avoids an unintended "dimmed opacity" look.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub get` -- resolves with the new font assets declared, no conflicts
- `fvm flutter test` -- all new token/widget tests pass
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues
- `grep -rn "Color(0x\|fontSize:\|EdgeInsets\.\(all\|symmetric\|only\)(" lib --include=*.dart | grep -v "core/design_tokens.dart"` -- expected: no matches (RNF08 literal check)

## Suggested Review Order

**Design tokens (RNF08 single source)**

- Entry point: every color/typography/spacing/radii/elevation constant, transcribed verbatim from the prototype panel.
  [`design_tokens.dart:10`](../../lib/core/design_tokens.dart#L10)
- "Components" and "Layout insets" groups are the two categories the prototype leaves unnamed — decided here, documented below.
  [`design_tokens.dart:195`](../../lib/core/design_tokens.dart#L195)
- Font assets bundled statically (not `google_fonts`) so widget tests stay deterministic with no device/CI.
  [`pubspec.yaml:106`](../../pubspec.yaml#L106)

**AppButton (shared primitive, three variants)**

- Variant switch — primary/secondaryOutline/textGhost share one disabled rule, diverge on fill/outline/ghost styling.
  [`app_button.dart:54`](../../lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart#L54)
- Patched post-review: `secondaryOutline`'s border now reads `borderWidthDefault` explicitly instead of silently defaulting to 1.0.
  [`app_button.dart:97`](../../lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart#L97)

**AppTextField (border states)**

- Default/focused/error borders resolved from tokens; patched post-review to correct a doc comment that overstated the error contract.
  [`app_text_field.dart:31`](../../lib/core/widgets/app_text_field.dart#L31)
- `errorMaxLines: null` — the Dynamic Type boundary: long error text wraps instead of truncating.
  [`app_text_field.dart:69`](../../lib/core/widgets/app_text_field.dart#L69)

**Avatar (fixed-size + Dynamic Type)**

- `FittedBox` shrinks initials to fit a fixed-size circle under extreme text scales, rather than growing the circle.
  [`avatar.dart:40`](../../lib/core/widgets/avatar.dart#L40)

**Tests (peripherals)**

- Token values spot-checked against the prototype extract, including the post-review layout-insets group.
  [`design_tokens_test.dart:1`](../../test/core/design_tokens_test.dart#L1)

333:### Story 1.3: Account Creation and Login
334-
335-As a new or returning user,
336-I want to create an account or log in with my email and password,
337-So that I can access my private journal.
338-
339-**Acceptance Criteria:**
340-
341-**Given** the Entrar / Criar conta screen in login mode
342-**When** I submit a valid, registered email and password
343-**Then** `POST /auth/login` succeeds and I land on Home/Chat with a persisted session.
344-
345-**Given** the same screen toggled to signup mode
346-**When** I submit an email and password
347-**Then** `POST /auth/signup` is called with exactly those two fields — no password-confirmation or display-name field exists anywhere on the screen (UX-DR31, resolves PRD OQ-2).
348-
349-**Given** an invalid login attempt
350-**When** the backend returns `AUTH_INVALID`
351-**Then** the error shows inline under the fields using the text-field's error-border treatment, and the field is never cleared.
352-
353-**Given** a malformed email
354-**When** I attempt to submit before any network call
355-**Then** client-side validation blocks the submit locally where possible, without a round trip.
356-**And** every call on this screen sends `apikey` plus `Authorization: Bearer <anon key>` per AD-5 — never a user token, since signup/login/refresh are the three `security: []` operations.
357-
358-### Story 1.4: Silent Session Refresh & Persistence
359-
360-As a returning user,
361-I want my session refreshed silently or remembered across app restarts,
362-So that I don't have to log in every time I open the app.
363-
364-**Acceptance Criteria:**
365-
366-**Given** a previously authenticated session with a valid, unexpired token
367-**When** I restart the app
368-**Then** I land on Home/Chat without being re-prompted for credentials.
369-
370-**Given** a session nearing or past expiry on app foreground
371-**When** the app checks session validity
372-**Then** it calls the session-check/refresh operation silently, with no visible loading UI unless the call exceeds the 300ms threshold (RNF01).
373-**And** exactly one `SessionStatus` stream is exposed from `features/auth/domain/` and registered once in DI as a singleton (AD-8) — no other code path re-derives session validity from a raw 401 or a second stream.

1	import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
2	
3	part 'failure.freezed.dart';
4	
5	/// AD-3 — the one closed `Failure` hierarchy, exactly 14 subtypes: the 13
6	/// codes from `docs/input/backend/error-taxonomy.md` plus the local-only
7	/// `malformedResponse` (client-side parse failure, never sent by the
8	/// backend). Never redefined or subset per feature; every repository method
9	/// returns `Either<Failure, T>` built from this type (RNF09).
10	///
11	/// `retryable` is derived here, once, from the 6 server `retryable:true`
12	/// codes (AD-4) — no other file re-decides which codes retry.
13	@freezed
14	sealed class Failure with _$Failure {
15	  const factory Failure.authExpired({required String message}) = AuthExpired;
16	  const factory Failure.authInvalid({required String message}) = AuthInvalid;
17	  const factory Failure.networkTimeout({required String message}) =
18	      NetworkTimeout;
19	  const factory Failure.networkOffline({required String message}) =
20	      NetworkOffline;
21	  const factory Failure.validation({required String message}) = Validation;
22	  const factory Failure.piiCheckFailed({required String message}) =
23	      PiiCheckFailed;
24	  const factory Failure.embeddingFailed({required String message}) =
25	      EmbeddingFailed;
26	  const factory Failure.aiGenerationTimeout({required String message}) =
27	      AiGenerationTimeout;
28	  const factory Failure.notFound({required String message}) = NotFound;
29	  const factory Failure.rateLimited({required String message}) = RateLimited;
30	  const factory Failure.exportEmptyPeriod({required String message}) =
31	      ExportEmptyPeriod;
32	  const factory Failure.payloadTooLarge({required String message}) =
33	      PayloadTooLarge;
34	  const factory Failure.ocrNoText({required String message}) = OcrNoText;
35	
36	  /// Local-only — the client's own parse-failure detection. `retryable` is
37	  /// hardcoded `false` for this subtype (AD-3).
38	  const factory Failure.malformedResponse({required String message}) =
39	      MalformedResponse;
40	
41	  const Failure._();
42	
43	  /// The 6 server `retryable:true` codes (AD-4). Every other code —
44	  /// including the local `malformedResponse` — is `false`.
45	  bool get retryable => switch (this) {
46	        NetworkTimeout() => true,
47	        NetworkOffline() => true,
48	        PiiCheckFailed() => true,
49	        EmbeddingFailed() => true,
50	        AiGenerationTimeout() => true,
51	        RateLimited() => true,
52	        AuthExpired() ||
53	        AuthInvalid() ||
54	        Validation() ||
55	        NotFound() ||
56	        ExportEmptyPeriod() ||
57	        PayloadTooLarge() ||
58	        OcrNoText() ||
59	        MalformedResponse() =>
60	          false,
61	      };
62	
63	  /// Maps a backend error `code` (`error-taxonomy.md`) to its `Failure`
64	  /// subtype. An unrecognized code (should never happen — the taxonomy is
65	  /// closed) falls back to [Failure.malformedResponse] rather than throwing,
66	  /// so no repository ever lets an unmapped error escape (RNF09).
67	  factory Failure.fromCode(String code, String message) => switch (code) {
68	        'AUTH_EXPIRED' => Failure.authExpired(message: message),
69	        'AUTH_INVALID' => Failure.authInvalid(message: message),
70	        'NETWORK_TIMEOUT' => Failure.networkTimeout(message: message),
71	        'NETWORK_OFFLINE' => Failure.networkOffline(message: message),
72	        'VALIDATION_ERROR' => Failure.validation(message: message),
73	        'PII_CHECK_FAILED' => Failure.piiCheckFailed(message: message),
74	        'EMBEDDING_FAILED' => Failure.embeddingFailed(message: message),
75	        'AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT' =>
76	          Failure.aiGenerationTimeout(message: message),
77	        'NOT_FOUND' => Failure.notFound(message: message),
78	        'RATE_LIMITED' => Failure.rateLimited(message: message),
79	        'EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD' => Failure.exportEmptyPeriod(message: message),
80	        'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE' => Failure.payloadTooLarge(message: message),
81	        'OCR_NO_TEXT' => Failure.ocrNoText(message: message),
82	        _ => Failure.malformedResponse(message: message),
83	      };
84	}

## 5. Implementation notes

1. **"29 frames" vs. "32 states":** the prototype has 32 distinct navigable states, but the number of frames (29) suggests that some state families should be one screen with internal state, not separate routes (e.g., a single `ExportSheet` with a status enum instead of 5 routes). Consider this when designing navigation.
2. **Account deletion without a success screen:** both "Sair" and "Apagar tudo" return to the Biometria screen; there is no "account deleted" or "you signed out" screen.
3. **Login vs. sign-up:** the same screen toggled by a text link; the prototype shows no extra sign-up fields (e.g., password confirmation, name). Whether sign-up needs extra fields is a product decision not covered visually.
4. **Insertion modal when offline:** not represented.
5. **Switching tabs in the insertion modal:** opening the modal always resets every tab to `idle`/empty, but switching tabs *during* a modal session is not cleared automatically — the expected behavior (e.g., whether an ongoing recording is discarded on tab switch) is not defined by the prototype.
6. **Per-entry sync indicator:** the states "sincronizado / sincronizando / erro de sync" exist visually on the cards, but no explicit "retry sync" action is shown for the error state. The semantics of the badge are in `docs/input/backend/sync-badge.md`.
7. **Text search combined with filters:** the filter sheet and the text search are on the same screen, but the prototype does not show them acting together.

        - asset: assets/fonts/Karla-Variable.ttf

6:paradigm: 'Clean Architecture (3-layer, feature-sliced) + BLoC presentation + Either-everywhere error channel'
26:## Design Paradigm
28:**Clean Architecture, 3 layers per feature, BLoC on top, errors carried as values.**
30:- `presentation/` (BLoC/Cubit + widgets) → depends on → `domain/` (entities, use cases, repository/port interfaces) ← implemented by ← `data/` (DTOs, data sources, repository implementations).
33:- `core/` sits beneath every feature and holds the only cross-feature-shared code: the `Failure` hierarchy, the API client/URL builder, the DI bootstrap, the local-cache boxes, `Resource<T>`, `isolatedSideEffect`, design tokens, and the `SessionStatus` contract.
38:        P["presentation (BLoC/Cubit, widgets)"]
44:    Core["core/ (Failure, ApiClient, DI, cache, Resource<T>, SessionStatus, VaultStatus, design_tokens)"]
51:## Invariants & Rules
53:### AD-1 — Layer dependency direction (RNF06)
59:### AD-2 — Either-everywhere error channel (RNF09)
63:- **Rule:** every repository method returns `Future<Either<Failure, T>>` (or `Stream<Either<Failure, T>>` for the chat SSE stream). `Failure` is the closed hierarchy in AD-3. No repository implementation lets a native/dio exception escape unmapped.
65:### AD-3 — Closed `Failure` hierarchy `[ADOPTED]`
71:### AD-4 — Retry policy lives in exactly one place `[ADOPTED]`
77:### AD-5 — Function-name URL construction and header policy
83:### AD-6 — `entries` owns `Entry` from RF01 onward; every other feature reaches it only through a domain-layer port
86:- **Prevents:** (a) RF01 inventing its own local `Entry` model/repository/cache box because `features/entries/` "doesn't exist yet" at its position in the delivery order, which RF06/RF07 would then duplicate; (b) any feature reaching into `entries`'s `data/`, repository, data source, or BLoC — the exact violation RF10's acceptance criteria calls out, which would also break RNF06.
89:### AD-7 — No BLoC-to-BLoC references
93:- **Rule:** a BLoC/Cubit constructor never takes another BLoC/Cubit as a dependency, same-feature or cross-feature. Composition of multiple independent state sources happens by injecting the underlying `domain/` streams/use-cases into each BLoC independently, or via `BlocListener`/`MultiBlocListener` in the widget tree — never a direct BLoC → BLoC reference.
95:### AD-8 — Single `SessionStatus` source of truth
97:- **Binds:** F000 (go_router redirect), RF07 (composite auth × sync × data state), any feature that needs session validity
99:- **Rule:** exactly one `SessionStatus` stream, exposed from the auth feature's `domain/`, registered once in DI as a singleton. Every consumer injects/listens to that stream; none re-derives session state from a raw 401, from its own `GET /auth/session` poll, or from a second stream. `SessionStatus` governs *server session validity only* — it composes with the local vault gate per AD-14, it does not replace it.
101:### AD-9 — Cloud-only: no offline write queue
107:### AD-10 — Sync badge is a pure client-side derivation (locks `sync-badge.md`)
113:### AD-11 — Entry immutability
119:### AD-12 — Shared view-state scoped to single-source-of-truth fetches `[ADOPTED]`
125:### AD-13 — `isolatedSideEffect` contract fixed now, implementation deferred `[ADOPTED]`
131:### AD-14 — One `go_router` redirect composes exactly two gates, in a fixed order: vault, then session
133:- **Binds:** F000 (builds the redirect skeleton + `SessionStatus` half), RF03 (plugs the vault half into the same redirect)
134:- **Prevents:** F000 and RF03 each building an independent navigation gate (two competing `redirect` callbacks, or RF03 bolting a second check onto screens individually) — `go_router` supports only one top-level `redirect`, so two independently-built gates cannot both "just work."
135:- **Rule:** the redirect composes exactly two domain-level streams, evaluated in this order: (1) `VaultStatus` (local-only — biometric/PIN unlocked, Face-ID-failed-offer-PIN, or locked after the 5-minute background timeout; RF03 exposes it from `features/vault/domain` the same way auth exposes `SessionStatus`, AD-8) — checked *first*, before any network state, because it gates whether the app may show anything at all; then (2) `SessionStatus` (AD-8) once the vault is unlocked. Neither gate ever reaches the server to validate itself (`POST /auth/login` is the only path that can produce `AuthInvalid`, per AD-3) — the vault is validated entirely on-device, consistent with the backend having no biometric-unlock endpoint.
137:### AD-15 — The local cache is a projection, never a query engine
143:## Consistency Conventions
148:| Errors | `Failure` sealed hierarchy (AD-3) everywhere; UI maps a `Failure` to copy using its `retryable` flag, never a hardcoded per-screen message list |
151:| Network envelope | one `ApiClient`/URL-builder + one header interceptor (AD-5); no feature constructs a request URL or header set itself |
152:| State composition | `Resource<T>` for single-source fetches (AD-12); no BLoC-to-BLoC references (AD-7) |
160:## Stack
168:| go_router | ^18.1.1 |
183:## Structural Seed
189:    network/                  # ApiClient, URL builder, header + retry interceptor (AD-4, AD-5)
190:    failure/                  # sealed Failure hierarchy, 14 subtypes (AD-3)
195:    session/                  # SessionStatus contract (AD-8) — implemented by features/auth
197:    auth/          # F000 — signup, login, refresh, logout, SessionStatus (owns AD-8)
217:    App -->|"apikey + Authorization\n(AD-5)"| Edge

26:## Design Paradigm
28:**Clean Architecture, 3 layers per feature, BLoC on top, errors carried as values.**
30:- `presentation/` (BLoC/Cubit + widgets) → depends on → `domain/` (entities, use cases, repository/port interfaces) ← implemented by ← `data/` (DTOs, data sources, repository implementations).
33:- `core/` sits beneath every feature and holds the only cross-feature-shared code: the `Failure` hierarchy, the API client/URL builder, the DI bootstrap, the local-cache boxes, `Resource<T>`, `isolatedSideEffect`, design tokens, and the `SessionStatus` contract.
38:        P["presentation (BLoC/Cubit, widgets)"]
44:    Core["core/ (Failure, ApiClient, DI, cache, Resource<T>, SessionStatus, VaultStatus, design_tokens)"]
51:## Invariants & Rules
53:### AD-1 — Layer dependency direction (RNF06)
59:### AD-2 — Either-everywhere error channel (RNF09)
63:- **Rule:** every repository method returns `Future<Either<Failure, T>>` (or `Stream<Either<Failure, T>>` for the chat SSE stream). `Failure` is the closed hierarchy in AD-3. No repository implementation lets a native/dio exception escape unmapped.
65:### AD-3 — Closed `Failure` hierarchy `[ADOPTED]`
71:### AD-4 — Retry policy lives in exactly one place `[ADOPTED]`
77:### AD-5 — Function-name URL construction and header policy
83:### AD-6 — `entries` owns `Entry` from RF01 onward; every other feature reaches it only through a domain-layer port
86:- **Prevents:** (a) RF01 inventing its own local `Entry` model/repository/cache box because `features/entries/` "doesn't exist yet" at its position in the delivery order, which RF06/RF07 would then duplicate; (b) any feature reaching into `entries`'s `data/`, repository, data source, or BLoC — the exact violation RF10's acceptance criteria calls out, which would also break RNF06.
89:### AD-7 — No BLoC-to-BLoC references
93:- **Rule:** a BLoC/Cubit constructor never takes another BLoC/Cubit as a dependency, same-feature or cross-feature. Composition of multiple independent state sources happens by injecting the underlying `domain/` streams/use-cases into each BLoC independently, or via `BlocListener`/`MultiBlocListener` in the widget tree — never a direct BLoC → BLoC reference.
95:### AD-8 — Single `SessionStatus` source of truth
97:- **Binds:** F000 (go_router redirect), RF07 (composite auth × sync × data state), any feature that needs session validity
99:- **Rule:** exactly one `SessionStatus` stream, exposed from the auth feature's `domain/`, registered once in DI as a singleton. Every consumer injects/listens to that stream; none re-derives session state from a raw 401, from its own `GET /auth/session` poll, or from a second stream. `SessionStatus` governs *server session validity only* — it composes with the local vault gate per AD-14, it does not replace it.
101:### AD-9 — Cloud-only: no offline write queue
107:### AD-10 — Sync badge is a pure client-side derivation (locks `sync-badge.md`)
113:### AD-11 — Entry immutability
119:### AD-12 — Shared view-state scoped to single-source-of-truth fetches `[ADOPTED]`
125:### AD-13 — `isolatedSideEffect` contract fixed now, implementation deferred `[ADOPTED]`
131:### AD-14 — One `go_router` redirect composes exactly two gates, in a fixed order: vault, then session
133:- **Binds:** F000 (builds the redirect skeleton + `SessionStatus` half), RF03 (plugs the vault half into the same redirect)
134:- **Prevents:** F000 and RF03 each building an independent navigation gate (two competing `redirect` callbacks, or RF03 bolting a second check onto screens individually) — `go_router` supports only one top-level `redirect`, so two independently-built gates cannot both "just work."
135:- **Rule:** the redirect composes exactly two domain-level streams, evaluated in this order: (1) `VaultStatus` (local-only — biometric/PIN unlocked, Face-ID-failed-offer-PIN, or locked after the 5-minute background timeout; RF03 exposes it from `features/vault/domain` the same way auth exposes `SessionStatus`, AD-8) — checked *first*, before any network state, because it gates whether the app may show anything at all; then (2) `SessionStatus` (AD-8) once the vault is unlocked. Neither gate ever reaches the server to validate itself (`POST /auth/login` is the only path that can produce `AuthInvalid`, per AD-3) — the vault is validated entirely on-device, consistent with the backend having no biometric-unlock endpoint.
137:### AD-15 — The local cache is a projection, never a query engine
143:## Consistency Conventions
148:| Errors | `Failure` sealed hierarchy (AD-3) everywhere; UI maps a `Failure` to copy using its `retryable` flag, never a hardcoded per-screen message list |
151:| Network envelope | one `ApiClient`/URL-builder + one header interceptor (AD-5); no feature constructs a request URL or header set itself |
152:| State composition | `Resource<T>` for single-source fetches (AD-12); no BLoC-to-BLoC references (AD-7) |

---
title: 'Story 1.3: Account Creation and Login'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-10-27'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context:
  - '{project-root}/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/epic-1-context.md'
  - '{project-root}/docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml'
  - '{project-root}/_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/architecture/architecture-cerne-ciclo-b-2026-10-26/ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** No `features/auth/` exists yet. There is no way for a user to create an account or log in — `main.dart` renders a static placeholder, and `core/` only has the token-storage *port* (`AccessTokenProvider`) and header policy (`auth-signup`/`auth-login` already anon-keyed) waiting for a real caller.

**Approach:** Build the `auth` feature (data/domain/presentation) backing the Tela 0.1a "Entrar / Criar conta" screen: two endpoints (`auth-signup`, `auth-login`) via the existing `ApiClient`, a `AuthRepository` returning `Either<Failure, AuthenticatedUser>`, local email/password validation, and a Cubit-driven screen reusing `AppTextField`/`AppButton` as-is. On success, save the access token and move past the screen via a temporary placeholder destination (no nav shell exists until Story 1.6).

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Signup posts exactly `{email, password}` to `auth-signup`; login posts the same shape to `auth-login` — no password-confirmation or display-name field anywhere (epics.md Story 1.3 AC, resolves PRD OQ-2).
- Both calls go through the existing `ApiClient`/`HeaderInterceptor` unchanged — `auth-signup`/`auth-login` are already in `HeaderInterceptor.anonKeyOnlyFunctions`, so no network-layer code changes.
- On success, save the access token via the existing `AccessTokenProvider.saveAccessToken` before the repository returns `right(...)`. Refresh-token persistence is explicitly Story 1.4's job — do not add storage for it here.
- `AUTH_INVALID` keeps typed field text, applies the error-border treatment to both fields, and shows the message once (epics.md AC: "the field is never cleared").
- Malformed email blocks submit locally (pure validator, no round trip) before any network call.
- Domain layer (`entities/`, `repositories/`, `validators/`) imports neither `flutter` nor `data/` (RNF06).

**Never:**
- No go_router / `SessionStatus` stream / silent refresh — Story 1.4/1.6 scope.
- No new params on `AppButton`/`AppTextField` — compose with what Story 1.2 shipped.
- No "usar biometria" link — Epic 2 (vault) isn't built; omit rather than ship a dead link.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Valid login | registered email + password, login mode | `auth-login` succeeds, token saved, navigates past the screen | N/A |
| Valid signup | any email + password, signup mode | `auth-signup` succeeds with exactly 2 fields, token saved, navigates past the screen | N/A |
| Invalid credentials | wrong password/unknown email | `Failure.authInvalid` → both fields get error border, message shown once, fields keep their typed values | inline, no retry |
| Malformed email | e.g. `nao-e-email`, tap submit | blocked before any network call, inline "E-mail inválido" | local only |
| Network failure | timeout/offline/malformed response | `Failure.message` shown once as the same inline error treatment | no retry button (RetryInterceptor already retried the retryable codes) |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/core/network/api_client.dart`, `header_interceptor.dart` -- reused as-is; `auth-signup`/`auth-login` already anon-keyed (AD-5).
- `lib/core/network/access_token_provider.dart` -- `saveAccessToken`/`clearAccessToken` already typed for this story; call from the new repository impl.
- `lib/core/failure/failure.dart` -- `AuthInvalid`/`Validation`/network subtypes already closed; map backend codes via existing `Failure.fromCode`.
- `lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart`, `app_text_field.dart` -- reused unchanged; `obscureText` covers password masking, `errorText: ''` gives a field the red border with no duplicate message text.
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:19-98` -- signup/login request `{email,password}` and response `{data:{session:{accessToken,...}, user:{id,email}}}` shapes.
- `_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/epics.md:333-356` -- Story 1.3's AC, authoritative over this spec's phrasing.
- `test/support/write_failure_matrix_helper.dart` -- reuse `runWriteFailureMatrix` for both new write endpoints.
- `lib/main.dart` -- replace the static placeholder: `MaterialApp.home` becomes the auth screen; add a throwaway post-auth placeholder (Splash/Biometria/nav shell are Epic 2/Story 1.6, not built here).
- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- call the new feature's `registerAuthFeature()` after `setupCoreDependencies()`.

New feature files (all under `lib/features/auth/`):
- `domain/entities/authenticated_user.dart` -- plain `{id, email}`, no freezed (too small to warrant codegen).
- `domain/repositories/auth_repository.dart` -- `Future<Either<Failure, AuthenticatedUser>> signUp/logIn({email, password})`.
- `domain/validators/auth_validators.dart` -- pure `validateEmail`/`validatePassword` functions (domain-layer, RNF06, ≥80% covered per RNF07).
- `data/models/auth_response_dto.dart` -- `@JsonSerializable()` DTOs for the signup/login response envelope.
- `data/datasources/auth_remote_data_source.dart` -- calls `ApiClient.post('auth-signup'|'auth-login', data: ...)`.
- `data/repositories/auth_repository_impl.dart` -- maps DTO → entity, saves the access token on success.
- `presentation/cubit/auth_state.dart`, `auth_cubit.dart` -- plain immutable state (mode, email, password, field errors, `Resource<Unit>` submission) + Cubit wrapping `AuthRepository` (no freezed, no cross-BLoC refs, AD-7).
- `presentation/screens/auth_screen.dart` -- Tela 0.1a, composes `AppTextField`×2 + `AppButton`, mode-toggle ghost button.
- `auth_injection.dart` -- `registerAuthFeature()`, registers data source + repository as lazy singletons in `sl`.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/features/auth/domain/entities/authenticated_user.dart` -- `{id, email}` entity -- domain contract for success
- [ ] `lib/features/auth/domain/repositories/auth_repository.dart` -- abstract port -- RNF09 Either pattern
- [ ] `lib/features/auth/domain/validators/auth_validators.dart` -- email regex + non-empty password -- blocks malformed submit locally
- [ ] `lib/features/auth/data/models/auth_response_dto.dart` -- signup/login response DTOs -- json_serializable per AGENTS.md
- [ ] `lib/features/auth/data/datasources/auth_remote_data_source.dart` -- `signUp`/`logIn` via `ApiClient.post` -- the 2 new write endpoints
- [ ] `lib/features/auth/data/repositories/auth_repository_impl.dart` -- DTO→entity + `saveAccessToken` on success -- RNF09, AD-5
- [ ] `lib/features/auth/presentation/cubit/auth_state.dart`, `auth_cubit.dart` -- mode/fields/validation/submission state -- drives the screen
- [ ] `lib/features/auth/presentation/screens/auth_screen.dart` -- login/signup toggle screen -- Tela 0.1a
- [ ] `lib/features/auth/auth_injection.dart` -- `registerAuthFeature()` -- wires into the single `sl`
- [ ] `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- call `registerAuthFeature()` -- bootstrap order
- [ ] `lib/main.dart` -- `MaterialApp.home` = `AuthScreen`; temporary post-auth placeholder screen -- F000 boundary, no real nav shell yet
- [ ] `test/features/auth/domain/validators/auth_validators_test.dart` -- valid/invalid email and password cases
- [ ] `test/features/auth/data/repositories/auth_repository_impl_test.dart` -- `runWriteFailureMatrix` ×2 (signup, login) + success-path DTO mapping + token-save assertion
- [ ] `test/features/auth/presentation/cubit/auth_cubit_test.dart` -- mode toggle, validation-blocks-submit, success, `AuthInvalid` surfacing
- [ ] `test/features/auth/presentation/screens/auth_screen_test.dart` -- the I/O matrix rows end-to-end through the widget tree, plus Dynamic Type

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given the login mode with a valid, registered email and password, when submitted, then `auth-login` is called with exactly `{email, password}` and no other field.
- Given signup mode, when submitted, then `auth-signup` is called with exactly `{email, password}` — no confirmation/display-name field exists anywhere on the screen.
- Given every call this screen makes, then it carries `apikey` plus `Authorization: Bearer <anon key>` (already guaranteed by `HeaderInterceptor`, asserted here for this story's two functions specifically).
- Given a successful call, when the repository returns, then the access token is persisted via `AccessTokenProvider` before the UI moves past the screen.

## Design Notes

- **Post-auth destination:** since `SessionStatus` (Story 1.4) and the `go_router` shell (Story 1.6) don't exist yet, success just swaps `main.dart`'s displayed screen to a small inline placeholder (not a new feature) via `Navigator.pushReplacement`. This is throwaway scaffolding Story 1.6 deletes wholesale — not a second navigation system.
- **No AppButton loading param:** rather than extend the shared widget (deferred in Story 1.2's review, re-decided here as unnecessary), the submit button is disabled mid-request and its label swaps to "Entrando…"/"Criando conta…", reusing the existing disabled visual rule for the RNF01 >300ms indicator.
- **Dual error-border without duplicate text:** `AppTextField.errorText` already treats any non-null value — including `''` — as "show the error border." On `AuthInvalid`, the email field gets `errorText: ''` (border only) and the password field gets the real message, satisfying "the error shows inline under the fields" (plural) without rendering the text twice.
- **No use-case layer:** the Cubit calls `AuthRepository` directly — no `SignUpUseCase`/`LogInUseCase` indirection, since nothing here is shared cross-feature (unlike RF10's explicit shared-interface requirement).

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub get` -- resolves, no conflicts
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- generates the new DTOs' `.g.dart`
- `fvm flutter test` -- all new and existing tests pass
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues
- `grep -rn "Color(0x\|fontSize:\|EdgeInsets\.\(all\|symmetric\|only\)(" lib/features/auth --include=*.dart` -- expected: no matches (RNF08)

On success, save the access token and move past the screen via a throwaway placeholder (no nav shell until Story 1.6).

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Signup/login post exactly `{email, password}` — no confirmation/display-name field (epics.md Story 1.3 AC, PRD OQ-2).
- Reuse `ApiClient`/`HeaderInterceptor` unchanged — `auth-signup`/`auth-login` are already in `anonKeyOnlyFunctions`.
- On success, call `AccessTokenProvider.saveAccessToken` before returning `right(...)`. Refresh-token persistence is Story 1.4's job — don't add it.
- `AUTH_INVALID`: fields keep typed values, both get the error border, message shown once.
- Malformed email blocks submit locally (pure validator), before any network call.
- Domain layer imports neither `flutter` nor `data/` (RNF06).

**Never:**
- No go_router / `SessionStatus` / silent refresh — Story 1.4/1.6 scope.
- No new params on `AppButton`/`AppTextField`.
- No "usar biometria" link — Epic 2 vault isn't built; omit rather than ship dead.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Valid login | registered email+password | `auth-login` succeeds, token saved, past the screen | N/A |
| Valid signup | any email+password, signup mode | `auth-signup` called with exactly 2 fields, token saved | N/A |
| Invalid credentials | wrong password/unknown email | `AuthInvalid` → both fields bordered, message once, values kept | inline, no retry |
| Malformed email | e.g. `nao-e-email`, submit tapped | blocked pre-network, inline "E-mail inválido" | local only |
| Network failure | timeout/offline/malformed | `Failure.message` shown as the same inline error | no manual retry (interceptor already retried) |

</frozen-after-approval>

Reused, unchanged:
- `lib/core/network/api_client.dart`, `header_interceptor.dart` -- `auth-signup`/`auth-login` already anon-keyed (AD-5).

- `lib/core/widgets/app_button.dart`, `app_text_field.dart` -- `obscureText` for password; `errorText: ''` = border-only, no text.

- [ ] `domain/validators/auth_validators.dart` -- email regex + non-empty password
- [ ] `data/models/auth_response_dto.dart` -- response DTOs -- json_serializable per AGENTS.md

- [ ] `data/repositories/auth_repository_impl.dart` -- mapping + token save
- [ ] `presentation/cubit/auth_state.dart`, `auth_cubit.dart` -- drives the screen

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given login mode with a valid, registered email/password, when submitted, then `auth-login` is called with exactly `{email, password}`.

## Intent

**Problem:** No `features/auth/` exists. `main.dart` is a static placeholder; `core/` only has the token-storage port and header policy waiting for a real caller.

**Approach:** Build the `auth` feature (data/domain/presentation) behind Tela 0.1a: signup/login via the existing `ApiClient`, an `AuthRepository` returning `Either<Failure, AuthenticatedUser>`, local validation, a Cubit-driven screen reusing `AppTextField`/`AppButton` unchanged. On success, save the token and move past the screen via a throwaway placeholder (no nav shell until Story 1.6).

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Signup/login post exactly `{email, password}` — no confirmation/display-name field (epics.md Story 1.3 AC, PRD OQ-2).
- Reuse `ApiClient`/`HeaderInterceptor` unchanged — `auth-signup`/`auth-login` are already in `anonKeyOnlyFunctions`.
- On success, call `AccessTokenProvider.saveAccessToken` before returning `right(...)`. Refresh-token persistence is Story 1.4's job — don't add it.
- `AUTH_INVALID`: fields keep typed values, both get the error border, message shown once.
- Malformed email blocks submit locally (pure validator), before any network call.
- Domain layer imports neither `flutter` nor `data/` (RNF06).

**Never:**
- No go_router / `SessionStatus` / silent refresh — Story 1.4/1.6 scope.
- No new params on `AppButton`/`AppTextField`.
- No "usar biometria" link — Epic 2 vault isn't built; omit rather than ship dead.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Valid login | registered email+password | `auth-login` succeeds, token saved, past the screen | N/A |
| Valid signup | any email+password, signup mode | `auth-signup` called with exactly 2 fields, token saved | N/A |
| Invalid credentials | wrong password/unknown email | `AuthInvalid` → both fields bordered, message once, values kept | inline, no retry |
| Malformed email | e.g. `nao-e-email`, submit tapped | blocked pre-network, inline "E-mail inválido" | local only |
| Network failure | timeout/offline/malformed | `Failure.message` shown as the same inline error | no manual retry |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

Reused as-is: `api_client.dart`/`header_interceptor.dart` (`auth-signup`/`auth-login` already anon-keyed, AD-5); `access_token_provider.dart` (`saveAccessToken`); `failure.dart` (`AuthInvalid`/`Validation`/`fromCode` already closed); `app_button.dart`/`app_text_field.dart` (`obscureText`, `errorText: ''` = border-only). Ground truth: `openapi.yaml:19-98` (`{email,password}` → `{data:{session:{accessToken,...}, user:{id,email}}}`); `epics.md:333-356` (AC, authoritative over this spec's wording); `write_failure_matrix_helper.dart` (reuse `runWriteFailureMatrix`).

Edited: `lib/main.dart` (home = auth screen + throwaway post-auth placeholder); `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` (call `registerAuthFeature()`).

New, under `lib/features/auth/`:
- `domain/entities/authenticated_user.dart` -- plain `{id, email}`, no freezed.
- `domain/repositories/auth_repository.dart` -- `Future<Either<Failure, AuthenticatedUser>> signUp/logIn({email, password})`.
- `domain/validators/auth_validators.dart` -- pure `validateEmail`/`validatePassword` (RNF06/07).
- `data/models/auth_response_dto.dart` -- `@JsonSerializable()` DTOs for the response envelope.
- `data/datasources/auth_remote_data_source.dart` -- `ApiClient.post('auth-signup'|'auth-login')`.
- `data/repositories/auth_repository_impl.dart` -- DTO→entity, saves token on success.

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** No `features/auth/` exists. `main.dart` is a static placeholder; `core/` only has the token-storage port and header policy waiting for a real caller.

**Approach:** Build the `auth` feature (data/domain/presentation) behind Tela 0.1a: signup/login via the existing `ApiClient`, an `AuthRepository` returning `Either<Failure, AuthenticatedUser>`, local validation, a Cubit-driven screen reusing `AppTextField`/`AppButton` unchanged. On success, save the token and move past the screen via a throwaway placeholder (no nav shell until Story 1.6).

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Signup/login post exactly `{email, password}` — no confirmation/display-name field (epics.md Story 1.3 AC, PRD OQ-2).
- Reuse `ApiClient`/`HeaderInterceptor` unchanged — `auth-signup`/`auth-login` are already in `anonKeyOnlyFunctions`.
- On success, call `AccessTokenProvider.saveAccessToken` before returning `right(...)`. Refresh-token persistence is Story 1.4's job — don't add it.
- `AUTH_INVALID`: fields keep typed values, both get the error border, message shown once.
- Malformed email blocks submit locally (pure validator), before any network call.
- Domain layer imports neither `flutter` nor `data/` (RNF06).

**Never:**
- No go_router / `SessionStatus` / silent refresh — Story 1.4/1.6 scope.
- No new params on `AppButton`/`AppTextField`.
- No "usar biometria" link — Epic 2 vault isn't built; omit rather than ship dead.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Valid login | registered email+password | `auth-login` succeeds, token saved, past the screen | N/A |
| Valid signup | any email+password, signup mode | `auth-signup` called with exactly 2 fields, token saved | N/A |
| Invalid credentials | wrong password/unknown email | `AuthInvalid` → both fields bordered, message once, values kept | inline, no retry |
| Malformed email | e.g. `nao-e-email`, submit tapped | blocked pre-network, inline "E-mail inválido" | local only |
| Network failure | timeout/offline/malformed | `Failure.message` shown as the same inline error | no manual retry |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

Reused as-is: `api_client.dart`/`header_interceptor.dart` (already anon-keyed, AD-5); `access_token_provider.dart` (`saveAccessToken`); `failure.dart` (`AuthInvalid`/`Validation`/`fromCode` already closed); `app_button.dart`/`app_text_field.dart` (`obscureText`, `errorText: ''` = border-only). Ground truth: `openapi.yaml:19-98` (`{email,password}` → `{data:{session:{accessToken,...}, user:{id,email}}}`); `epics.md:333-356` (AC, authoritative); `write_failure_matrix_helper.dart` (`runWriteFailureMatrix`).

Edited: `lib/main.dart` (home = auth screen + throwaway post-auth placeholder); `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` (call `registerAuthFeature()`).

New, under `lib/features/auth/`:
- `domain/entities/authenticated_user.dart` -- plain `{id, email}`, no freezed.
- `domain/repositories/auth_repository.dart` -- `Future<Either<Failure, AuthenticatedUser>> signUp/logIn({email, password})`.
- `domain/validators/auth_validators.dart` -- pure `validateEmail`/`validatePassword` (RNF06/07).
- `data/models/auth_response_dto.dart` -- `@JsonSerializable()` DTOs for the response envelope.
- `data/datasources/auth_remote_data_source.dart` -- `ApiClient.post('auth-signup'|'auth-login')`.
- `data/repositories/auth_repository_impl.dart` -- DTO→entity, saves token on success.
- `presentation/cubit/auth_state.dart`, `auth_cubit.dart` -- mode/fields/errors/`Resource<Unit>` submission; calls `AuthRepository` directly, no use-case indirection.
- `presentation/screens/auth_screen.dart` -- Tela 0.1a: 2×`AppTextField` + `AppButton` + ghost toggle.
- `auth_injection.dart` -- `registerAuthFeature()`, lazy singletons in `sl`.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `domain/entities/authenticated_user.dart`, `domain/repositories/auth_repository.dart` -- entity + abstract port (RNF09)
- [ ] `domain/validators/auth_validators.dart` -- email regex + non-empty password
- [ ] `data/models/auth_response_dto.dart` -- response DTOs, json_serializable per AGENTS.md
- [ ] `data/datasources/auth_remote_data_source.dart` -- the 2 write calls
- [ ] `data/repositories/auth_repository_impl.dart` -- mapping + token save
- [ ] `presentation/cubit/auth_state.dart`, `auth_cubit.dart` -- drives the screen
- [ ] `presentation/screens/auth_screen.dart` -- Tela 0.1a
- [ ] `auth_injection.dart` + `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- DI wiring
- [ ] `lib/main.dart` -- home = `AuthScreen` + throwaway post-auth placeholder
- [ ] `test/features/auth/domain/validators/auth_validators_test.dart` -- valid/invalid cases
- [ ] `test/features/auth/data/repositories/auth_repository_impl_test.dart` -- `runWriteFailureMatrix` ×2 + success mapping + token-save assertion
- [ ] `test/features/auth/presentation/cubit/auth_cubit_test.dart` -- toggle, validation-blocks-submit, success, `AuthInvalid`
- [ ] `test/features/auth/presentation/screens/auth_screen_test.dart` -- I/O matrix rows + Dynamic Type

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given login/signup mode, when submitted, then `auth-login`/`auth-signup` is called with exactly `{email, password}` — no extra field anywhere.
- Given a successful call, when the repository returns, then the access token is persisted before the UI moves past the screen.

## Design Notes

- **Post-auth destination:** `SessionStatus` (1.4) / `go_router` (1.6) don't exist yet — success swaps `main.dart`'s screen to a small inline placeholder via `Navigator.pushReplacement`, deleted wholesale by Story 1.6.
- **No `AppButton` loading param:** submit disables mid-request, label swaps to "Entrando…"/"Criando conta…", reusing the disabled-visual rule for RNF01's indicator — no shared-widget change.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub get` -- resolves, no conflicts
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- generates the new DTOs' `.g.dart`
- `fvm flutter test` -- all tests pass
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues
- `grep -rn "Color(0x\|fontSize:\|EdgeInsets\.\(all\|symmetric\|only\)(" lib/features/auth --include=*.dart` -- expected: no matches (RNF08)

**Problem:** No `features/auth/` exists. `main.dart` is a static placeholder; `core/` only has the token-storage port and header policy waiting for a real caller.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Signup/login post exactly `{email, password}` — no confirmation/display-name field (epics.md Story 1.3 AC, PRD OQ-2).

- `AUTH_INVALID`: fields keep typed values, both get the error border, message shown once.

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Valid login | registered email+password | `auth-login` succeeds, token saved, past the screen | N/A |

| Network failure | timeout/offline/malformed | `Failure.message` shown as the same inline error | no manual retry |

Reused as-is: `api_client.dart`/`header_interceptor.dart` (already anon-keyed, AD-5); `access_token_provider.dart` (`saveAccessToken`); `failure.dart` (`AuthInvalid`/`Validation`/`fromCode` already closed); `app_button.dart`/`app_text_field.dart` (`obscureText`, `errorText: ''` = border-only). 15	## Intent
16	
17	**Problem:** No `features/auth/` exists. `main.dart` is a static placeholder; `core/` only has the token-storage port and header policy waiting for a real caller.

On success, save the token and move past the screen via a throwaway placeholder (no nav shell until Story 1.6).

21	## Boundaries & Constraints
22	
23	**Always:**
24	- Signup/login post exactly `{email, password}` — no confirmation/display-name field (epics.md Story 1.3 AC, PRD OQ-2).
25	- Reuse `ApiClient`/`HeaderInterceptor` unchanged — already in `anonKeyOnlyFunctions`.
26	- On success, call `AccessTokenProvider.saveAccessToken` before returning `right(...)`. Refresh-token persistence is Story 1.4's job.
27	- `AUTH_INVALID`: fields keep typed values, both get the error border, message shown once.
28	- Malformed email blocks submit locally (pure validator), before any network call.
29	- Domain layer imports neither `flutter` nor `data/` (RNF06).
30

32	- No go_router / `SessionStatus` / silent refresh — Story 1.4/1.6 scope.
33	- No new params on `AppButton`/`AppTextField`.
34	- No "usar biometria" link — Epic 2 vault isn't built; omit rather than ship dead.
35	
36	## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
37	
38	| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
39	|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
40	| Valid login | registered email+password | `auth-login` succeeds, token saved, past the screen | N/A |
41	| Valid signup | any email+password, signup mode | `auth-signup` called with exactly 2 fields, token saved | N/A |
42	| Invalid credentials | wrong password/unknown email | `AuthInvalid` → both fields bordered, message once, values kept | inline, no retry |
43	| Malformed email | e.g. `nao-e-email`, submit tapped | blocked pre-network, inline "E-mail inválido" | local only |
44	| Network failure | timeout/offline/malformed | `Failure.message` shown as the same inline error | no manual retry |
45	
46	</frozen-after-approval>

type: 'feature'
created: '2026-10-27'

---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** No `features/auth/` exists. `main.dart` is a static placeholder; `core/` only has the token-storage port and header policy waiting for a real caller.

**Approach:** Build the `auth` feature (data/domain/presentation) behind Tela 0.1a: signup/login via the existing `ApiClient`, an `AuthRepository` returning `Either<Failure, AuthenticatedUser>`, local validation, a Cubit-driven screen reusing `AppTextField`/`AppButton` unchanged. On success, save the token and move past the screen via a throwaway placeholder (no nav shell until Story 1.6).

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Signup/login post exactly `{email, password}` — no confirmation/display-name field (epics.md Story 1.3 AC, PRD OQ-2).
- Reuse `ApiClient`/`HeaderInterceptor` unchanged — already in `anonKeyOnlyFunctions`.
- On success, call `AccessTokenProvider.saveAccessToken` before returning `right(...)`. Refresh-token persistence is Story 1.4's job.
- `AUTH_INVALID`: fields keep typed values, both get the error border, message shown once.
- Malformed email blocks submit locally (pure validator), before any network call.
- Domain layer imports neither `flutter` nor `data/` (RNF06).

**Never:**
- No go_router / `SessionStatus` / silent refresh — Story 1.4/1.6 scope.
- No new params on `AppButton`/`AppTextField`.
- No "usar biometria" link — Epic 2 vault isn't built; omit rather than ship dead.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Valid login | registered email+password | `auth-login` succeeds, token saved, past the screen | N/A |
| Valid signup | any email+password, signup mode | `auth-signup` called with exactly 2 fields, token saved | N/A |
| Invalid credentials | wrong password/unknown email | `AuthInvalid` → both fields bordered, message once, values kept | inline, no retry |
| Malformed email | e.g. `nao-e-email`, submit tapped | blocked pre-network, inline "E-mail inválido" | local only |
| Network failure | timeout/offline/malformed | `Failure.message` shown as the same inline error | no manual retry |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

Reused as-is: `api_client.dart`/`header_interceptor.dart` (already anon-keyed, AD-5); `access_token_provider.dart` (`saveAccessToken`); `failure.dart` (`AuthInvalid`/`Validation`/`fromCode` already closed); `app_button.dart`/`app_text_field.dart` (`obscureText`, `errorText: ''` = border-only). Ground truth: `openapi.yaml:19-98` (`{email,password}` → `{data:{session:{accessToken,...}, user:{id,email}}}`); `epics.md:333-356` (AC, authoritative); `write_failure_matrix_helper.dart` (`runWriteFailureMatrix`).

Edited: `lib/main.dart` (home = auth screen + throwaway post-auth placeholder); `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` (call `registerAuthFeature()`).

New, under `lib/features/auth/`:
- `domain/entities/authenticated_user.dart` -- plain `{id, email}`, no freezed.
- `domain/repositories/auth_repository.dart` -- `Future<Either<Failure, AuthenticatedUser>> signUp/logIn({email, password})`.
- `domain/validators/auth_validators.dart` -- pure `validateEmail`/`validatePassword` (RNF06/07).
- `data/models/auth_response_dto.dart` -- `@JsonSerializable()` response DTOs.
- `data/datasources/auth_remote_data_source.dart` -- `ApiClient.post('auth-signup'|'auth-login')`.
- `data/repositories/auth_repository_impl.dart` -- DTO→entity, saves token on success.
- `presentation/cubit/auth_state.dart`, `auth_cubit.dart` -- mode/fields/errors/`Resource<Unit>`; calls `AuthRepository` directly, no use-case.
- `presentation/screens/auth_screen.dart` -- Tela 0.1a: 2×`AppTextField` + `AppButton` + ghost toggle.
- `auth_injection.dart` -- `registerAuthFeature()`, lazy singletons in `sl`.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `domain/entities/authenticated_user.dart`, `domain/repositories/auth_repository.dart` -- entity + abstract port (RNF09)
- [x] `domain/validators/auth_validators.dart` -- email regex + non-empty password
- [x] `data/models/auth_response_dto.dart` -- response DTOs, json_serializable per AGENTS.md
- [x] `data/datasources/auth_remote_data_source.dart` -- the 2 write calls
- [x] `data/repositories/auth_repository_impl.dart` -- mapping + token save
- [x] `presentation/cubit/auth_state.dart`, `auth_cubit.dart` -- drives the screen
- [x] `presentation/screens/auth_screen.dart` -- Tela 0.1a
- [x] `auth_injection.dart` + `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` -- DI wiring
- [x] `lib/main.dart` -- home = `AuthScreen` + throwaway post-auth placeholder
- [x] `test/features/auth/domain/validators/auth_validators_test.dart` -- valid/invalid cases
- [x] `test/features/auth/data/repositories/auth_repository_impl_test.dart` -- `runWriteFailureMatrix` ×2 + success mapping + token-save assertion
- [x] `test/features/auth/presentation/cubit/auth_cubit_test.dart` -- toggle, validation-blocks-submit, success, `AuthInvalid`
- [x] `test/features/auth/presentation/screens/auth_screen_test.dart` -- I/O matrix rows + Dynamic Type

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given login/signup mode, when submitted, then `auth-login`/`auth-signup` is called with exactly `{email, password}` — no extra field anywhere.
- Given a successful call, when the repository returns, then the access token is persisted before the UI moves past the screen.

## Design Notes

- **Post-auth destination:** `SessionStatus` (1.4) / `go_router` (1.6) don't exist yet — success swaps `main.dart`'s screen to a small inline placeholder via `Navigator.pushReplacement`, deleted wholesale by Story 1.6.
- **No `AppButton` loading param:** submit disables mid-request, label swaps to "Entrando…"/"Criando conta…", reusing the disabled-visual rule for RNF01's indicator — no shared-widget change.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub get` -- resolves, no conflicts
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- generates the new DTOs' `.g.dart`
- `fvm flutter test` -- all tests pass
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- zero issues
- `grep -rn "Color(0x\|fontSize:\|EdgeInsets\.\(all\|symmetric\|only\)(" lib/features/auth --include=*.dart` -- expected: no matches (RNF08)

5	/// Tela 0.1a's two modes — toggled by a text link, never a separate screen

9	/// Drives [AuthScreen]: mode, the two field values, their errors, and the
10	/// in-flight submit status.
11	///
12	/// [emailError] and [formError] are mutually exclusive by construction
13	/// (`AuthCubit.submit` only ever sets one): a malformed email is caught
14	/// locally before any network call and only ever populates [emailError];
15	/// `AUTH_INVALID`/any other call failure only ever populates [formError],
16	/// always after local validation already passed.
17	class AuthState {
18	  const AuthState({
19	    this.mode = AuthMode.login,
20	    this.email = '',
21	    this.password = '',
22	    this.emailError,
23	    this.formError,
24	    this.status = const ResourceIdle<Unit>(),
25	  });
26	
27	  final AuthMode mode;
28	  final String email;
29	  final String password;
30	
31	  /// Inline "E-mail inválido" from local validation. Shown under the e-mail
32	  /// field only.
33	  final String? emailError;
34	
35	  /// `AUTH_INVALID`/`Failure.message` from the backend call. Shown once,
36	  /// under the senha field, while *both* fields get the error border (the
37	  /// e-mail field via `errorText: ''`, border-only).
38	  final String? formError;
39	
40	  final Resource<Unit> status;
41	
42	  bool get isSubmitting => status is ResourceLoading<Unit>;
43	
44	  AuthState copyWith({
45	    AuthMode? mode,
46	    String? email,
47	    String? password,
48	    String? emailError,
49	    bool clearEmailError = false,
50	    String? formError,
51	    bool clearFormError = false,
52	    Resource<Unit>? status,
53	  }) {
54	    return AuthState(
55	      mode: mode ?? this.mode,
56	      email: email ?? this.email,
57	      password: password ?? this.password,
58	      emailError: clearEmailError ? null : (emailError ?? this.emailError),
59	      formError: clearFormError ? null : (formError ?? this.formError),
60	      status: status ?? this.status,
61	    );
62	  }

66	      identical(this, other) ||
67	      (other is AuthState &&
68	          other.mode == mode &&
